 Raw results, Oct. 26, 2026: Liv Morgan survives title match against Becky Lynch, Tiffany Stratton nearly cashes in
 With Stephanie Vaquer not medically cleared to compete, The Judgment Day helped Women’s World Champion Liv Morgan retain the title via a disqualification loss to Becky Lynch, and Ms. Money in the Bank Tiffany Stratton nearly cashed in her contract. Plus, Sami Zayn scored a controversial win in his Undisputed WWE Title defense against Je’Von Evans, Bayley triumphed over Lyra Valkyria in a brutal No Disqualification Match, and so much more.
